surface: Frontend send gate blocks chat when sourceListStatus is loading/partial/error
root_cause: Retrieval/source readiness is treated as provider precondition
fix_direction: Remove sourceListStatus from hard send/input/button disable; send SourceScope kind none; show warning only
acceptance_gate: UI/static test: sourceListStatus=error with input sends getSourceScope kind none

surface: Spawned chat task can return without terminal event on gate cancellation
root_cause: Cancellation path records trace only; frontend never receives clearable terminal event
fix_direction: Create emit_chat_terminal helper and require chat:cancelled/chat:error/chat:done for every spawned exit
acceptance_gate: Static gate: no return after spawn-start without terminal call; notebook switch clears isStreaming

surface: App filters terminal events by activeNotebookId before chatStore sees them
root_cause: Viewed notebook is confused with active stream identity
fix_direction: Route all chat lifecycle events to chatStore first; chatStore gates by streamingNotebookId/messageId
acceptance_gate: Switch notebook mid-stream, terminal event still clears stream

surface: Assistant DB persist failure still leads to chat:done
root_cause: Provider completion is treated as user-visible completion even when durable assistant write fails
fix_direction: Treat DB insert failure as terminal error/partial-save failure; do not emit done unless persisted or cancellation/partial artifact exists
acceptance_gate: Mock DB insert error: no chat:done, trace assistant_persisted=false, UI clears with recoverable error

surface: GenerationReceiptV1 marks partial_persisted true before DB persistence
root_cause: Receipt semantics are ahead of durable state
fix_direction: Split provider stream receipt from AssistantPersistenceReceiptV1 / PartialGenerationReceiptV1
acceptance_gate: Receipt test: no assistant_persisted/partial_persisted true until DB write succeeds

surface: Stop/cancel is frontend-local and contradicts backend persistence truth
root_cause: UI clears state before authoritative backend cancellation receipt
fix_direction: Implement backend cancellation receipt + chat:cancelled terminal event; UI waits or timeout-fallbacks with receipt
acceptance_gate: Stop test: backend emits cancel receipt and frontend clears from terminal event

surface: Done-frame coverage is marker-level only
root_cause: Test does not run token->done(true)->no EOF through backend+frontend
fix_direction: Add fake provider integration test and frontend event test
acceptance_gate: Test fails if done=true without EOF leaves stream open

surface: Provider smoke and last trace functions exist but are not operator visible
root_cause: Correct diagnostic primitive exists but is hidden from user/debug flow
fix_direction: Add Settings/Chat buttons: Run Ollama provider smoke, Copy last ChatAttemptTraceV1, Copy provider config summary
acceptance_gate: Manual UI proof: trace can be copied after failed/successful chat

surface: Local providers reject LAN URLs by policy
root_cause: Only loopback allowed despite LAN Ollama being common operator topology
fix_direction: Add explicit allow_lan_local_providers default false; allow RFC1918/private only with opt-in; keep rejecting public/credential/query/fragment
acceptance_gate: Provider tests cover loopback/LAN default/LAN opt-in/public/credentials/query/fragment

surface: Default model qwen3:8b can be stale/missing
root_cause: Default model is seeded independent of actual Ollama model list
fix_direction: On provider/model refresh validate default exists; if missing choose with notice or block with explicit model selection error
acceptance_gate: Fixture: missing default but one model available yields explicit repair/notice

surface: Provider Test conflates reachability with selected-model chat readiness
evidence: Settings provider test path vs debugChatProviderSmoke
root_cause: Connectivity check does not prove chat endpoint/model works
fix_direction: Split Provider Reachable and Chat Smoke
acceptance_gate: UI shows both results with trace phase

surface: Provider URL save does not force model registry refresh
root_cause: Model registry/default model may remain stale after URL change
fix_direction: Refresh models after provider save or mark models stale and require refresh before chat
acceptance_gate: Changing URL updates model list before chat send

surface: sendMessage invoke-return branch can preserve streaming after context mismatch
root_cause: Frontend assumes later events will clean up after it returns on mismatched active notebook/conversation
fix_direction: Introduce ActiveStreamState independent of active conversation; route terminal by stream id
acceptance_gate: Conversation switch during invoke cannot leave isStreaming=true

surface: Notebook switch policy split between store preservation and App event filtering
root_cause: State preservation and event filters conflict
fix_direction: Centralize lifecycle in chatStore; App filters only display/toasts
acceptance_gate: E2E notebook switch no orphan spinner

surface: Source status partial/error becomes chat availability failure
evidence: src/stores/sourceStore.ts stats mismatch; ChatPanel disables send
root_cause: Index/stats drift blocks unrelated local chat
fix_direction: Partial/error is retrieval degradation only; add DB doctor/index refresh CTA
acceptance_gate: Stats mismatch fixture still allows chat kind none

surface: Retrieval decision can still be unclear to user
root_cause: User cannot tell no-retrieval vs degraded retrieval vs selected source failure
fix_direction: Add retrieval decision card attached to each answer with reason codes and source scope
acceptance_gate: Answer without sources shows explicit no-retrieval disclosure

surface: Semantic-memory/TurboQuant claims still require live proof receipts
evidence: Prior audit receipts missing or not release-grade
root_cause: Dependency/feature presence is being treated as capability proof
fix_direction: Add live dense index, semantic memory, and TQ receipts with fixture corpus and UI proof
acceptance_gate: Fresh run creates LIVE_*_RECEIPT.json and shows in UI

surface: User visible done can precede durable DB write
root_cause: Completion semantics collapse provider stream complete and durable user-visible message complete
fix_direction: Define terminal event ordering: provider_complete -> persistence_success -> evidence_persisted -> chat:done
acceptance_gate: Trace ordering test asserts done after persistence success

surface: Partial output recovery is not durable enough
evidence: stopStreaming message says partial not saved
root_cause: Timeout/error/cancel discards/relegates partial content
fix_direction: Persist PartialGenerationV1 with continuation action and recovery UI
acceptance_gate: Interrupt after tokens: partial record exists and Continue uses it

surface: Package root includes broad /Coding top-level material
evidence: report included top-level paths beyond Gloss/Libraries
root_cause: Codex context package and release source package are conflated
fix_direction: Separate Gloss release package root from Codex context pack; gate top-level paths
acceptance_gate: Fresh package scope gate passes and excludes unrelated /Coding files

surface: run_all_checks references validation file excluded from package
root_cause: Secret filename heuristic excludes active validator
fix_direction: Rename validator or add allowlist by digest; run_all_checks may not reference missing files
acceptance_gate: Fresh package no script-ref-not-archived

surface: Codex archive current_run is stale P30
root_cause: Multiple run-truth surfaces are not reconciled
fix_direction: Introduce CurrentRunTruthV1; generate CURRENT_RUN, final receipt, codex-archive sidecar from it
acceptance_gate: Run truth gate compares all current-run projections

surface: Expected root files not packaged due archive-root confusion
root_cause: Adapter expects root at /Coding while app root is Gloss
fix_direction: Make z.py app_root vs archive_root aware; expected-file checks evaluated against Gloss root
acceptance_gate: Warnings disappear or are scoped

surface: Aggregate release gate can hang/timed out in prior audit
root_cause: Child command stop law missing/insufficient
fix_direction: Every validation child has timeout, JSON result, stdout/stderr path, and aggregate never hangs
acceptance_gate: Run under timeout returns structured pass/fail JSON

surface: Tauri security audit currently fails dialog save permission justification
root_cause: Permission surface wider than proven or validator stale
fix_direction: Map every Tauri permission to frontend callsite; remove or justify precisely
acceptance_gate: audit_tauri_security.py emits permission-to-callsite map and passes

surface: Secret scanner mixes real risk, vendor fixtures, and validator filenames
root_cause: All secret hits treated same; active validator excluded
fix_direction: Classify real secret/test fixture/vendor fixture/validator false positive; redact real, manifest fixtures by digest
acceptance_gate: Secret scan has zero unclassified active findings

surface: Rust build/test not independently verified in this sandbox
root_cause: No fresh local Rust receipts attached
fix_direction: Run cargo fmt/check/test/clippy locally and include logs/receipts in package
acceptance_gate: Fresh command receipts with toolchain versions

surface: User sees spinner/error ambiguity instead of branch classification
evidence: No trace UI; status text not enough
root_cause: Operational branch is invisible
fix_direction: Add Chat Failure Inspector panel with phase, provider, model, URL class, first token, done, persistence, terminal event
acceptance_gate: Failed chat immediately shows branch and copy trace button

surface: Model/settings UI does not prevent stale provider/model choice
root_cause: User can select unavailable/stale model or not understand disabled state
fix_direction: Disable send with explicit selected-model error only, not spinner; one-click refresh/select
acceptance_gate: Unavailable model shows actionable error before request

surface: Release/public claims can outrun evidence
root_cause: Docs/final receipts can claim pass while gates fail
fix_direction: Public claim boundary doc generated from final gates only
acceptance_gate: README/push decision generated from gate JSON; no manual contradiction

surface: Codex runs keep broadening instead of proving one branch
root_cause: Execution lacks stop law and verification-first branch proof
fix_direction: Use bounded phases and subagents only for audits; no feature broadening before chat proof
acceptance_gate: Each phase has max scope, gate, rollback, receipt
